description: Sou interessado em ciência, tecnologia e exploração espacial. Quero desenvolver o MARSYNC, um projeto inovador sobre Marte. Busco pessoas criativas, comprometidas e com habilidades em programação, design, pesquisa e tecnologia. Juntos, podemos transformar ideias em soluções!
summary:
MARSYNC is an educational website that shows the real Mars using NASA and ESA data. We explain Gale Crater, Mount Sharp, and the Boxwork formations studied by the Curiosity rover in a simple and visual way for students.
 Our project includes an interactive exploration map where users can mark points, analyze simulated altitude, slope and radiation, and create a route A → B → C to plan a mission base. MARSYNC helps young people understand how we could survive on Mars.
details: MARSYNC is a website built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It presents real information about Mars: distance from Earth, temperature, Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, Gale Crater, Curiosity, Perseverance and Ingenuity. The main feature is the Boxwork Mission Map. The user can click on the map to create custom points, see simulated altitude, slope, radiation index and risk classification, and calculate an estimated EVA walking route. The map uses a mathematical illustrative model, not official NASA elevation data, and we clearly explain this limitation. The benefit is to make space science accessible and easy to understand for students, using simple language and visual explanations. The creative aspect is combining storytelling, real data and an interactive planning tool in one mobile-friendly site. Our team considered education, simplicity and scientific honesty.
